problem.description: The current problem, and who it affects. Leave out unless the latest lines change it.

outcome.description: The observable improvement once the change ships. Leave out unless the latest lines change it.

included.description: What the change includes. Leave out unless the latest lines change it.

excluded.description: What is explicitly out of scope. Leave out unless the latest lines change it.

constraints.description: Limits the change must respect: permissions, privacy, performance, compatibility. Only those that apply, cited or agreed, never invented. Leave out unless the latest lines change it.

statement.description: The rule as one sentence that holds in every case, failure, cancellation, and retry included.

given.description: The starting situation. One line. Null while unknown.

when.description: The action. One line. Null while unknown.

then.description: The observable result. One line. Null while unknown.

examples.description: Concrete examples that pin the rule, each exactly given, when, and then; more of them where the rule is ambiguous or two implementations could read it differently. Null until one is agreed.

rules.description: The behavioral rules, each with the examples that pin it. Null until one is agreed.

changeMap.description: Each repository-relative path the change touches or adds, and what it gets there. Leave out unless the latest lines change it.

contracts.description: New or changed types, schema, and signatures at module boundaries, written as code in fenced blocks against the plan's commit. Signatures only, never function bodies. Leave out unless the latest lines change it.

patterns.description: Existing code to follow, by path, and what to copy from it. Leave out unless the latest lines change it.

pseudocode.description: Pseudocode Luke showed the developer, for logic whose order or branches matter. Written by Luke's own tool; left out of the document while absent. Leave out unless the latest lines change it.

order.description: Only where one step must land before another: the steps in order and why. Left out of the document while null. Leave out unless the latest lines change it.

decisions.description: Each consequential choice: the decision, why, and the alternative rejected. Leave out unless the latest lines change it.

verification.description: The end-to-end check that proves the change works, beyond the examples passing. Leave out unless the latest lines change it.

leftToAgent.description: Exactly which choices the implementing agent may make itself; everything else is fixed. Leave out unless the latest lines change it.

openQuestions.description: Unresolved questions, contradictions, or facts no source could settle; empty when none.

dataAndMigration.description: Only when stored data changes: what is stored, how existing data moves, and how the change is undone. Left out of the document while null. Leave out unless the latest lines change it.

assumptions.description: Every assumption the plan holds, in order, each its text. Sent whole when any changes.
